Get turns

Source: R/query-tables.R
get_actions.Rd

Reads the actions table, or the v_actions_display view with display = TRUE: one row per turn (action). Turns by exact column values, e.g. all question turns in 1977. Interjections are included: no turn-type filter is applied unless you pass one.

Usage

get_actions(
  action_id = NULL,
  subdebate_id = NULL,
  action_type = NULL,
  is_interjection = NULL,
  page_no = NULL,
  source_path = NULL,
  speaker_no = NULL,
  turn_no = NULL,
  nonspeech_type = NULL,
  presiding_phid = NULL,
  has_quote = NULL,
  is_petition = NULL,
  is_motion_no_speech = NULL,
  is_speech = NULL,
  is_question = NULL,
  is_answer = NULL,
  is_non_speech = NULL,
  sitting_id = NULL,
  time_of_day = NULL,
  PHID = NULL,
  resolution = NULL,
  reason = NULL,
  chamber = NULL,
  chamber_venue = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  ...,
  display = FALSE,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

action_id

Filter on column action_id (VARCHAR).

subdebate_id

Filter on column subdebate_id (VARCHAR).

action_type

Filter on column action_type (VARCHAR).

is_interjection

Filter on column is_interjection (BOOLEAN).

page_no

Filter on column page_no (INTEGER).

source_path

Filter on column source_path (VARCHAR).

speaker_no

Filter on column speaker_no (INTEGER).

turn_no

Filter on column turn_no (INTEGER).

nonspeech_type

Filter on column nonspeech_type (VARCHAR).

presiding_phid

Filter on column presiding_phid (VARCHAR).

has_quote

Filter on column has_quote (BOOLEAN).

is_petition

Filter on column is_petition (BOOLEAN).

is_motion_no_speech

Filter on column is_motion_no_speech (BOOLEAN).

is_speech

Filter on column is_speech (BOOLEAN).

is_question

Filter on column is_question (BOOLEAN).

is_answer

Filter on column is_answer (BOOLEAN).

is_non_speech

Filter on column is_non_speech (BOOLEAN).

sitting_id

Filter on column sitting_id (VARCHAR).

time_of_day

Filter on column time_of_day (TIME).

PHID

Filter on column PHID (VARCHAR).

resolution

Filter on column resolution (VARCHAR).

reason

Filter on column reason (VARCHAR).

chamber

Filter on chamber (VARCHAR): "house" and/or "senate", in any case.

chamber_venue

Filter on column chamber_venue (TINYINT).

year

Filter on column year (SMALLINT).

...

Must be empty. It forces the arguments after it to be named.

display

If TRUE, read the v_actions_display view, which adds display columns to the table's own. Filters still apply.

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per turn (action) and every column of actions (or of v_actions_display) (zero rows if nothing matches), or a lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

Every column except content and *_raw columns is a filter argument, spelt as in the database. Each takes NULL (no filter, the default), a vector of values to match, in_range() for an inclusive range, or matches_pattern() for a case-insensitive pattern. Filters combine with AND. Stored values are returned unchanged, and no other filter is applied.

Generated from the database catalog by data-raw/generate-getters.R; for tables without a getter use db_tbl().

See also

in_range(), matches_pattern(), db_tbl()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
get_actions(action_type = "question", year = in_range(1990, 2000))
